comment: Icon ligature names to include in the subsetted Material Symbols Rounded font. Add a name here, run `npm run icons`, and commit the regenerated font. Names are Google Material Symbols ligatures; a few legacy names (error_outline, mail_outline, phone) do not exist in the current font and must use their modern equivalents (error, mail, call). Some names are also trapdoors that look plausible but do not exist: `flash` is only flash_on/flash_off/flash_auto, so the Android FlashOn icon maps to flash_on.
